title: Boolean word from a finite index set
statement: For a finite type $\alpha$, a natural number $L$, and a Boolean-valued function $a$ on $\alpha$, form a Boolean word of length $L$. Its coordinate $i$ is the value of $a$ at the element with index $i$ in the standard enumeration of $\alpha$ when $i<|\alpha|$, and is false otherwise.
